description:
Connect a Cloudflare API token to a domain for automated DNS record management. Note: the API token will be visible in the AI conversation context.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Set PROOF_API_KEY and restart this server, or sign in with start_login — a session opens this tool — then call this tool again.

api_token.description: Cloudflare API token with DNS edit permissions

name: connect_cloudflare
